rescue package without verification, called for sustainable health structures, criticized Deutsche Bahn’s continuing crisis, noted increasing federal funding of state-government tasks, and addressed sustainability in the federal budget.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.6","5B.7","6B.2","6B.5","6B.9","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The reports were issued from January through April measure.","limitations":["Only report titles and dates are supplied; the excerpts do not establish the scale of each problem or corrective action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"Amnesty reported that during 2023 Germany lacked effective, independent complaint mechanisms for discriminatory police abuses; authorities preemptively banned several Palestine-solidarity protests, used preventive detention against climate activists, saw increased politically motivated raids and attacks in refugee reception centers, and was found by a court to have violated the Federal Climate Protection Act.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.9","5B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report explicitly covers 1 January through 31 December 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern German authorities and the federal government’s legal and institutional framework during Scholz’s chancellorship; not every local action is directly attributable to the chancellor.","limitations":["Amnesty is an external human-rights monitor and the excerpt does not identify Scholz’s personal orders."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"The German Interior Ministry reported that politically motivated crime reached a new high in the prior reporting year; Amnesty recorded approximately seven antisemitic hate crimes per day, with 2023 increases in hate crimes against Roma and Sinti (33%), people targeted for sexual orientation (15%), racism (14%), anti-foreigner hostility (13%), and xenophobia (9%).","question_ids":["3B.6","3B.7","3B.9","3B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report was issued for 2023, although the politically motivated crime baseline cited was reported by the ministry as the preceding year.","ruler_attribution":"The figures describe Germany during Scholz’s term and do not establish that Scholz personally caused the trends.","limitations":["The excerpt does not provide exposure-adjusted rates or demonstrate the causal effect of federal policy."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In March 2023, Germany amended the Transfusion Act to end the discriminatory exclusion of gay and bisexual men and trans people from blood donation; parliament also debated a self-determination law for legal gender recognition.","question_ids":["3B.7","4B.7","6B.8","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The amendment was enacted in March 2023; the gender-recognition measure remained under debate during the reporting period.","ruler_attribution":"The fact concerns parliamentary action by the federal government and legislature during Scholz’s coalition government.","limitations":["The supplied text does not identify Scholz’s individual role in the legislative process."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, German authorities imposed blanket or preventive bans on multiple Palestine-solidarity demonstrations, including around the May Nakba commemoration; after 7 October, reports described disproportionate police force, hundreds of arrests, and increased racial profiling of people perceived as Arab or Muslim.","question_ids":["3B.3","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The events occurred during May and after 7 October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The actions involved Berlin and other authorities, while the federal Interior Ministry also restricted expression later in the year; the excerpt does not show a personal Scholz directive.","limitations":["The source reports alleged or documented practices but does not provide a complete national administrative record."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Before an international automobile fair in September 2023, Bavaria used preventive-detention powers to hold at least 27 climate activists for up to 30 days without a concrete suspicion of a criminal offense or an initiated criminal case.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The detentions occurred in September 2023.","ruler_attribution":"This was a Bavarian state-police measure rather than a demonstrated personal decision by Scholz or the federal cabinet.","limitations":["The supplied text does not state whether federal authorities intervened or reviewed the measure."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, police used pain holds and other force during peaceful demonstrations, and investigations under the criminal-organization provision included extensive searches, surveillance of a press telephone, and seizure of supporters’ personal data, creating a chilling effect on peaceful protest.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The reported practices and investigations occurred during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The conduct was attributed to police and state prosecutors; the excerpt does not establish Scholz’s personal authorization.","limitations":["The source summarizes media reports and does not provide final judicial findings for each incident."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In November 2023, the Federal Interior Ministry banned the slogan “From the river to the sea” as a Hamas symbol, although Amnesty noted that the slogan had previously been used with multiple meanings by different actors.","question_ids":["3B.5","3B.8","4B.3","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The federal ban occurred in November 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The action was taken by the Federal ban."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Germany hosted about 1.1 million people from Ukraine, with approximately 900,000 holding residence permits under the temporary-protection directive.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"The population and permit figures are reported for 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The figures reflect Germany’s federal temporary-protection framework during Scholz’s government, while service delivery also involved states and municipalities.","limitations":["The excerpt does not measure service quality, access, or outcomes for these residents."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"Germany’s humanitarian admission program for vulnerable Afghans, launched in October 2022 with an intended intake of 1,000 people per month, had admitted only 94 Afghan nationals by mid-December 2023.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.6","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The excerpt does not explain the causes of the shortfall or whether the target was later revised."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In 2023, attacks on refugees and refugee accommodation increased substantially compared with 2022, while family-reunification procedures remained slow and left many families separated for years; family reunification for people with subsidiary protection remained quota-limited and discretionary.","question_ids":["3B.7","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","6B.7","6B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The findings concern 2023 levels.","limitations":["The excerpt does not provide the absolute number of attacks or quantify processing delays."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In February 2023, the Federal Constitutional Court imposed high barriers on police use of automated data analysis, finding that such analysis interfered with informational self-determination.","question_ids":["3B.4","3B.5","4B.9"],"polarity":"exculpatory","period_fit":"The judgment occurred in February 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The court independently constrained police powers during Scholz’s term; the fact does not show whether the government promptly amended all affected rules.","limitations":["The supplied text does not identify the specific statute or subsequent implementation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The Supply Chain Due Diligence Act entered into force on 1 January 2023, requiring companies with at least 3,000 employees to respect human rights, with the threshold scheduled to fall to 1,000 employees in 2024; the law created no civil-law liability.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The law entered into force during 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The rates."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In June 2023, the cabinet adopted a Climate Protection Act amendment that would abolish binding sector emissions targets and the associated duty to submit immediate programs after noncompliance; in November, a court confirmed that building and transport sector targets had been missed in 2021 and 2022.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","5B.9","8B.2","8B.6","8B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The cabinet decision and court confirmation occurred in 2023, although the missed excerpt does not state the amendment’s final legislative status by the end of 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-4b82d7345d4c0abe","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Despite Germany’s commitment to end financing for international fossil-fuel projects from 2022, state promotional banks approved financing for at least three such projects in 2023.","question_ids":["1B.10","5B.1","5B.6","5B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The financing approvals occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The finding concerns state July.","question_ids":["2B.7","3B.4","4B.4","6B.8","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Ratification and entry into the complaint mechanism occurred in 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The humanitarian-law risks.","question_ids":["1B.5","1B.6","2B.4","2B.5","2B.8","2B.9","4B.6","5B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The export-control changes and approvals are reported for while noting opaque party financing, insufficient lobbying regulation, and inconsistent state-level
